text: Residents have reached out to my office with concerns about speeding along their street, and requested that traffic calming measures (speed bumps) be installed as a method of addressing these concerns. My office polled the homes and there was strong support from the residents for making this change. I am requesting that speed humps be installed on Roblin Avenue between O'Connor Drive and Plains Road.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Waived the polling requirement under the City's Traffic Calming Policy and authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Roblin Avenue, between O'Connor Drive and Plains Road. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install two speed humps on Roblin Avenue, between O'Connor Drive and Plains Road, generally as shown on the attached Drawing No. TC-105, dated November 2022, from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
